name: veliom
description: Ultra-fast, minimal frontend framework with API-agnostic design

scripts.build: tsc && tsc --project tsconfig.cjs.json && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('dist/cjs/package.json', JSON.stringify({ type: 'commonjs' }))" && vite build
scripts.smoke:esm: node --input-type=module -e "import('./dist/veliom.js').then(m => { if (typeof m.h !== 'function' || typeof m.renderToString !== 'function') { console.error('ESM smoke failed'); process.exit(1); } console.log('ESM smoke ok'); }).catch(e => { console.error(e); process.exit(1); })"
scripts.smoke:cjs: node -e "const m = require('./dist/cjs/veliom.js'); if (typeof m.h !== 'function' || typeof m.renderToString !== 'function') { console.error('CJS smoke failed'); process.exit(1); } console.log('CJS smoke ok');"
scripts.smoke: npm run smoke:esm && npm run smoke:cjs
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run smoke

author: DerStr1k3r
